completeOriginalSourceQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve KNOWING EVERYTHING ABOUT ONE FACTION'S PAST,PRESENT AND LIKELY FUTURE; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Define valid existing faction selection,scope of faction-related facts and a practical knowledge-retrieval procedure. Retain past/present breadth while distinguishing likely forecasts from guaranteed future events and from unrelated personal secrets. Resolve conflicting records,hidden branches,wards and absent authored facts without inventing faction history.
